subject.title: marketplace-crons: eBay rechaza creates por política de título o descripción

question: For eBay create failures containing `Issue_172_Block`, account-limited text, or counterfeit-policy wording, should Hamelyn classify them as per-SKU permanent catalog errors, account-level transient blocks, or split them by message family?
rationale: The source fix is small, but the wrong policy can either bury recoverable account restrictions or keep non-recoverable catalog/policy rejects in the retry pool.

options.title: Split by message family
options.body: Classify counterfeit/content-policy rejections as `PERMANENT`, but route account-limited seller blocks to an account-level alert/hold with explicit requeue after eBay clears the restriction.

options.title: Treat all as permanent
options.body: Stop retries immediately for every observed variant, accepting that account-level recovery will require manual SKU requeue.

options.title: Keep account blocks retryable
options.body: Only add permanent rules for item/content policy and leave account-limited cases transient or unknown until the seller account state is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Split by message family
recommendation.body: Classify counterfeit/content-policy rejections as `PERMANENT`, but route account-limited seller blocks to an account-level alert/hold with explicit requeue after eBay clears the restriction.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently marked this issue confirmed-live in the marketplace-sync area and have recent history around the eBay marketplace surface.
